design_condition: Placed close to the existing school buildings, the volume turns the playground into a courtyard while extending westward and creating another spacious outdoor area.

positive.statement: The proposal impresses with a very balanced solution to the situation and volumetrics appropriate to the existing school system.

position.rationale: Elongated, symmetric three-storey volume is clearly visible across top and elevation views.

positive.statement: The internal organization largely meets the requirements.

position.rationale: Interior organization is not exposed; approximate anchor is distributed within the central building mass.

positive.statement: The access areas receive zenithal daylight through skylights and openings.

position.rationale: Circulation openings are suggested within the central volume but not directly distinguishable from the exterior sample.

positive.statement: The facade construction takes up the proportions and architectural and structural character of the existing school building.

position.rationale: Long horizontal facade bands and repeated proportions are directly visible in elevation views.

negative.statement: The large access areas can only be used to a limited extent for school operations, while narrow classroom pre-zones may lead to conflicts.

position.target: large access areas and classroom pre-zones
position.rationale: Interior circulation zones are approximated inside the elongated mass because the point cloud does not reveal rooms.

negative.statement: The strict basic structure and inflexible access zones make adaptation to changing educational requirements difficult.

position.rationale: Inflexible access is assigned to a representative internal zone within the repetitive building structure.

negative.statement: The classrooms are relatively limited in size, while several other areas significantly exceed the required space.

position.rationale: Classrooms are not individually visible; the marker approximates a representative upper-level internal zone.

negative.statement: The outdoor-space design remains very schematic, with no evidence of replacing felled trees.

position.rationale: The courtyard and surrounding exterior areas are visible in the top view, though planting is not represented.

negative.statement: The covered bicycle parking beside the main entrance should be assessed very critically.

position.rationale: Main-entrance adjacency is approximated on the western side; the bicycle shelter itself is indistinguishable.

negative.statement: The investment costs are around ten percent higher, directly resulting from the high proportion of development and traffic areas.

position.rationale: The cost criticism references circulation-heavy site areas, approximated around the courtyard-facing ground plane.

negative.statement: The proposal creates only very limited, freely playable learning landscapes and little scope for changing pedagogical requirements.

position.rationale: Limited learning landscape is assigned to the sparse eastern outdoor area visible beside the building.
